**The verdict** (rule 1): no comparison step in the chain - the run's front alone (Iteration 427). **A stall at
generations 43-44** (about 12:33-14:06 by the chain's clock; results/drafts/stall-seed94.py): generation 44 to 45 took
93 minutes against 3.8 a generation, runs and compiles slow enough that 18 timed out and 4 compiles hit cc's 60 s CPU
limit - 5 fast-end designs measured again (in-run 0.1265-0.1310) and 17 children never measured; the one 32-bit failure
of no known cause, 3b5bdaebbc (generation 44), the same - built here at 4-byte cells, right on kernel, apps and fib.
It cost about 24 generations (136 against seed 93's 160). None of the 5 measured would have been on the front (each
dominated at four objectives); the 17 never measured, about 0.1 front entries at the run's 0.77 % a child. **The
fastest at 32 bits, 0.1426, is a wrong reading**: 2806f89619 (generation 44, in the stall) leads by one workload, its
32-bit kernel 0.119 where its parent 202caee13c (two genes apart: factor, regpin) reads 0.362 and the next of the 50
fastest at 32 bits 0.296 - its other workloads its parent's. Built here at 4-byte cells, its kernel takes 1.019 of its
parent's time (21 rounds alternating, tools/cputime.c; results/drafts/ktime-seed94.py); with its parent's kernel its
32-bit speed is 0.1672, dominated. Struck from the stopping line (Iteration 700's judgment; the owner: "ensure we don't
lose any good designs and proceed") so seed 95's bars are not set by it: without it the hypervolume 0.31733 (+0.0 % on
seed 93's 0.31731; with it 0.31886) and the fastest at 32 bits 1aa6659e9d 0.1496 (-0.6 %) - the 32-bit bar 0.1466, not
0.1398. The design stays in the database: seed 95 carries its front and measures it again. **The stopping rule**, then:
seed 94 gains by the least memory alone - 104 KB against 108 KB, the 4 KB threshold exactly, by two designs carried in
from seeds 84-90's records (02c3dba611, 8b62078c98: 108 KB there; 1a704e01f9 read 104 at seed 90, 108 here) - one page
on a re-measure, not a new design. The rule counts it (the extremes from every alive design), so the count is 3 runs on
the method and the earliest stop after seed 96. The fastest 0.1216 (-0.1 %), the smallest 22,409 B (-2 B), the
hypervolume flat: seed 94 found nothing new - no 2 % speed gain in-run, the size's one gain at generation 4. For the
owner: the memory's 4 KB threshold is one page, the noise of a design measured again. Held out (sieve): Spearman 0.912
(seed 93 0.891), the fastest tenth 0.717, the pick +12.9 % (seed 93 +4.5 %). The curse 1.090. Predictions (Iteration 699): (1) wrong, (2) right, (3) right,
(4) wrong, (5) wrong (results/predictions.md).
